items.title: Malin Ullgren: No Swedish writer has as much of his own universe as PO
items.summary: PO Enquist must be constantly relevant - this spring he is very much so, even though it is now six years since he died. DN's Malin Ullgren reads a new anthology about the border-crossing writer.
items.title_original: Malin Ullgren: Ingen svensk författare har ett lika eget universum som PO
items.summary_original: PO Enquist må vara ständigt aktuell – i vår är han det alldeles särskilt mycket, trots att det nu är sex år sedan han dog. DN:s Malin Ullgren läser en ny antologi om den gränsöverskridande författaren.

items.title: Is Alpine's flagship model a family SUV or a sports car?
items.summary: Alpine is trying to keep up with the electric car world and is now launching its flagship model, the A390. It is a so-called coupe SUV that should be both sporty and spacious. The question is, is it good at any of it?
items.title_original: Är Alpines flaggskeppsmodell en familjesuv eller en sportbil?
items.summary_original: Alpine försöker hänga med i elbilsvärlden och lanserar nu sin flaggskeppsmodell A390. Det är en så kallad coupésuv som ska vara både sportig och rymlig. Frågan är om den är bra på något av det?

items.title: Hagman and Roberts have done their part: "I hope you don't stand there and sob"
items.summary: Sunday's EC qualifying match will be the end of an era in the Swedish national handball team. After that, Jamina Roberts and Nathalie Hagman – the two who have played the most international matches of all time on the women's side – give their thanks. - It will probably be emotional. Just hope you don't start crying, says Roberts.
items.title_original: Hagman och Roberts har gjort sitt: ”Hoppas man inte står där och hulkar”
items.summary_original: Söndagens EM-kvalmatch blir slutet på en era i svenska handbollslandslaget. Efter den tackar Jamina Roberts och Nathalie Hagman – de två som spelat flest landskamper genom tiderna på damsidan – för sig. – Det kommer nog vara känslosamt. Hoppas bara inte man börjar gråta, säger Roberts.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard visits Spain
items.summary: Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard visited Spain on 26 March. She visited the Swedish Honorary Consulate in Torrevieja and met with expatriate Swedes, civil society organisations and political representatives. Ms Malmer Stenergard also attended the Sweden-Ukraine men’s football World Cup qualifier match.

items.title: Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren welcomes Germany to For Forest+
items.summary: Sweden is this year’s chair of the For Forest+ group. In this context, Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren hosted a meeting of the group’s members on 31 March, during which the group welcomed Germany as a new member. With the addition of Germany, For Forest+ now consists of eight EU Member States that collectively account for around 60 per cent of the forests of the 27 EU Member States (EU27).

items.title: Prime Minister receives European Parliament President Roberta Metsola
items.summary: Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson received President of the European Parliament Roberta Metsola on Friday, 27 March. Together, the leaders visited Stockholm’s stock exchange, Nasdaq Stockholm, and discussed ways to strengthen the EU’s capital markets and competitiveness.
